_README: Testimonial videos, rendered by script.js (§7c) into #tVideos. EDIT THIS FILE to add/remove/reorder videos — no HTML changes needed. RULES: (1) NEVER invent a client name or quote — leave 'name' empty ('') until the client gives written permission, then put ONLY their first name. (2) 'src' is the video file (or a YouTube/Vimeo is possible via a future provider field). If 'src' is empty, the entry renders as a plain photo with NO play icon. (3) 'poster' is the thumbnail image. (4) caption_es / caption_en are the bilingual labels.
